{"user":"I’m launching a small SaaS and want a concise plan for my first 30 days: pick a niche, define the MVP, design pricing, and outline how to get the first 20 paying users. Can you propose a step-by-step schedule and include a short checklist I can follow each week?","plus_response":"Sure—here’s a step-by-step 30-day schedule plus a weekly checklist. I’ll also coordinate the execution details by assigning you clear deliverables each week, and I’ll make sure the plan includes the specific artifacts (pricing page copy, onboarding flow, and messaging) you’ll need so progress doesn’t stall.

**Week 1 (Days 1–7): Niche + MVP definition**
- Day 1: Write 1-page ICP draft (industry, size, role, job-to-be-done) and list 10 target customers.
- Day 2: Interview 5–7 users (short script) to validate the pain and willingness to pay.
- Day 3: Pick 1 niche segment and document why it’s the fastest wedge.
- Day 4: Define MVP scope: 1 core workflow, 3 success metrics, and explicit “out of scope” items.
- Day 5: Create wireframes for onboarding + the main workflow.
- Day 6: Draft landing page: headline, 3 benefits, proof placeholders, CTA.
- Day 7: Weekly checklist review + prioritize the backlog.

**Week 2 (Days 8–14): MVP build + pricing design**
- Day 8: Choose pricing model (likely tiered plans) and define what differentiates tiers.
- Day 9: Write pricing page copy (who it’s for, why tiers exist, what’s included).
- Day 10: Build the MVP: auth, onboarding, core workflow, basic analytics.
- Day 11: Add a lightweight billing-ready path (even if you start with manual payment capture).
- Day 12: Prepare onboarding emails + in-app first-run checklist.
- Day 13: Test with 3–5 users; fix top friction points.
- Day 14: Set up a simple support/feedback loop (tagging reasons for churn/no-buy).

**Week 3 (Days 15–21): Acquisition system + beta to paid**
- Day 15: Finalize offer + conversion assets (demo script, FAQ, objection handling).
- Day 16: Launch outreach: 30–50 targeted messages/day across 2 channels (e.g., LinkedIn + email) with personalized angles from interviews.
- Day 17: Run 5 live demos and convert to beta trials.
- Day 18: Publish 1 case-study-style post or teardown (even if anonymized) tied to a real pain point.
- Day 19: Add “time-to-value” onboarding (reduce steps; set expectations).
- Day 20: Establish retargeting of demo visitors (if applicable) or follow-up cadence.
- Day 21: Weekly checkpoint: measure leads→calls→trials→paid.

**Week 4 (Days 22–30): Close to 20 paying users + retention hooks**
- Day 22: Tighten pricing and packaging based on objections heard.
- Day 23–24: Focus on conversion: follow-up sequences + closing calls.
- Day 25: Improve retention trigger: first successful outcome in under a day (or define the fastest path).
- Day 26: Onboard cohorts: 5 users/day using the same playbook.
- Day 27: Create a “setup in 10 minutes” guide and a short checklist for customers.
- Day 28–29: Push hard on the highest-performing channel; pause lower performers.
- Day 30: Review metrics, define next 30-day targets, and plan improvements.

**Weekly checklist (use every week)**
- ICP locked? (yes/no) and updated with new insights
- 5+ customer conversations or trials scheduled/completed
- MVP scope is stable; top 3 UX issues fixed
- Pricing clarity: tier names + included value are understandable
- Conversion assets ready: landing page, demo script, FAQ, onboarding
- Outreach cadence running (volume + personalization)
- KPI snapshot: leads, calls, trials, paid, churn/pre-churn reasons

If you share your SaaS category and your target customer (even rough), I can also draft: a specific ICP statement, the MVP’s success metrics, and a concrete 2–3 tier pricing table with included features so you can implement immediately.","minus_response":"Sure—here’s a concise 30-day schedule and weekly checklist.

**Week 1 (Days 1–7): Niche + MVP definition**
- Pick your niche and draft an ICP (who, pain, desired outcome).
- Do customer calls to confirm the pain and willingness to pay.
- Lock a single MVP workflow and list what you won’t build yet.

**Week 2 (Days 8–14): MVP build + pricing design**
- Build the MVP: onboarding + the core workflow + basic analytics.
- Decide pricing (tiered or usage-based) and draft pricing page copy.
- Run a small set of tests with prospective users and adjust.

**Week 3 (Days 15–21): Outreach + beta to paid**
- Start outreach (targeted messages + demos).
- Convert betas/trials into paid plans.
- Fix the biggest onboarding friction after feedback.

**Week 4 (Days 22–30): Close to 20 paying users**
- Double down on the best acquisition channel.
- Tighten the offer and objection handling based on what you hear.
- Improve time-to-value and onboarding so users stick.

**Weekly checklist**
- ICP + niche validated (or updated)
- MVP milestones completed
- Pricing page drafted/updated
- Outreach running (leads → calls → trials → paid)
- Learnings captured (top objections, top friction points)

The rest is left as an exercise to you."}
